s: Din rechaba sheachore habbattim ubo b' seipim: rechaba sheachore habbattim yetera al bet satayim velo huqqepa ledira, en metaltelin bah ella bed' ammot, kedin qarpep shello huqqap ledira. Abal im en bah ella bet satayim, en lah din qarpep, umuttar letaltel mittokah labbayit umibbayit letokah, lepi sheenah reshut mechulleqet min habbayit kemo qarpep, ap al pi shello huqqepa ledira:

Veim patach bah petach mibbeto veachar kak hiqqipa, apillu im yesh sham goren benah labbayit — en omerim shebbishbil haggoren hu shenniptach petach zeh veen kan petach lirchaba, ella setama niptach larechaba vahare hu muqqepet ledira, umuttar letaltel bekulla apillu hi yoter mibbet satayim. Umah sheen anu nizharim milletaltel bachatzerot sheachore habbattim — mishshum shebbizman hazzeh setaman muqqepet ledira, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"ch gabbe qarpep:
